title: H1 substantiation output (arm T, stage B)
description: Stage B substantiates; it does not discover. Every assessment descends from a discovery finding by finding_id and carries discovery's mechanism verbatim in discovery_mechanism; a finding B cannot trace to discovery is a validation failure (internal/orchestrator/ancestry.go), not a prompt request. The judge (pre-registration s6) reads B's final mechanism on the highest-ranked surviving finding, so assessments are ranked and mechanism is B's last word. The RISKY verdict for T reads this stage's disposition; it is computed by the scorer, never emitted here.

review_a_ref.description: Checksum or identifier of the discovery output this assessment was built from.

assessments.description: RANKED over survivors: the CONFIRMED and NARROWED assessments come first, ordered by consequence-if-real times confidence as B now judges them; REJECTED and INCONCLUSIVE follow in any order. Array order is the rank; the judge reads the first survivor. Every finding handed over should appear once; a missing one is scored as dropped.

notes.description: Anything B noticed that is NOT an assessment of a discovery finding - including something new it found while building a chain. The scorer ignores this field and the judge never sees it. Discovery is stage A's job; a new finding here does not become a finding.

finding_id.description: The discovery finding id this assessment resolves, copied exactly. Checked against the handed-over discovery output.

discovery_mechanism.description: Discovery's mechanism text for this finding, unchanged. Checked verbatim against the handed-over output.

disposition.description: CONFIRMED: discovery's mechanism stands as written. NARROWED: the condition or consequence is tighter than discovery said. REJECTED: it does not hold, for a stated positive reason. INCONCLUSIVE: could not be settled from the code. T's verdict rule counts CONFIRMED and NARROWED at severity >= medium as RISKY; the other two never do.

mechanism.description: B's final statement of the failure mode, required for survivors. CONFIRMED: identical to discovery_mechanism (checked). NARROWED: the tighter statement, which must differ (checked). This is what the judge compares to the fixing diff.

rejection_reason.description: Required when REJECTED: the positive reason it does not hold, from the code.

causal_chain.description: Ordered repository evidence from cause to effect, for every disposition - the evidence for rejecting is a chain too. Citations are checked against the snapshot.

recommended_validation.description: Required for survivors. B's own, and it replaces discovery's for scoring: this field is scored by path match against the fixing commit, not by mechanism, so refining it once the chain is built is the point of brief s8.
Same contract as discovery: a hit is a named test file or directory the fix touched or added; 'add a regression test' scores nothing.
